author: Animan
description:
She rejected him… but when he walked away, everything changed.
Here are the Top 10 Anime Where Girl Rejects Boy Then Regrets It.
From slow-burn emotional damage in Oregairu to brutal heartbreak in White Album 2, these anime show what happens when love is taken for granted… and lost forever.
If you enjoy romance anime with rejection, regret, and character development — this list will hit HARD.
💬 Which anime hurt you the most? Comment below!
